_comment: Cloud Report Agent config. The agent turns minimised intake + Desiree's call notes into a structured, six-part, benchmarked, science-led DRAFT. It never emails a client and never bypasses the human approval gate. Runs via Claude Code on Desiree's Claude Pro/Max subscription — NO per-token API cost (subject to the plan's usage limits). Inputs are pseudonymised (client ref, not name/contact) and account training is turned OFF.
auth_note: Claude Code logged in with the Pro/Max subscription on the server (claude login); no API key. Turn OFF training in the Claude account; send only pseudonymised inputs. A commercial API/Team plan + DPA is the belt-and-braces upgrade for health data.

human_gate.note: Draft only. Desiree edits & approves before Generate.

data_minimisation: Send only intake fields + call notes needed for the report; strip direct identifiers where possible.
